C1034.title: Software Employees Implant Backdoor in Wallet App to Steal User Credentials and Millions in Cryptocurrency
C1034.summary: Three employees at a Shanghai software company, Liu, Dong, and Zhang A, conspired to implant a backdoor in a cryptocurrency wallet application. The backdoor uploaded private keys and mnemonic phrases to a designated server after installation. Another former colleague, Zhang B, implanted a backdoor in a different wallet and transferred virtual currency worth millions of yuan from a victim.

references.title: Who Took His Million-Yuan Virtual Currency?
